digest.component_or_area: rebar fsck repair tool and tickets store maintenance
propositions: The tickets store contains 550 stale-channel snapshots, 10 orphan LINK events spanning 9 tickets, and 1 STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED audit finding; 8 tickets have mixed stale/orphan faults and 1 is orphan-only; repair must preserve exactly 4 intentional resolved-fork audit records.

A new `--repair --only=stale-channel` selector must reconstruct snapshots lacking compiled_state.creation_channel by rebuilding from retained CREATE events and commit/push through the existing batched repair path, while refusing tickets with concurrent SNAPSHOT_INCONSISTENT or ORPHAN_EVENT findings.

The AUTO-RECOVER orphan repair path must run first on all 10 LINK events to clear the 8 mixed-fault tickets before stale-channel-only batches can proceed safely; any HUMAN-TRIAGE orphans present must abort pre-mutation.

Dry-run mode must report selected tickets with zero file writes or commits; `--limit=N` must make stale-channel repair resumable by ticket count; push failure must abort before any later batch; unknown `--only` values and `--only` without `--repair` must exit 2 with operator-readable errors.

Post-repair fsck verification must report zero SNAPSHOT_STALE_CHANNEL, zero ORPHAN_EVENT, zero missing/corrupt findings, and exactly the 4 recorded STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED ticket IDs (4214-ac28-d19c-41b9, 72d5-79ec-9e2e-4a2b, b043-9490-32ca-4548, fc9e-8c2e-cb2f-465f); rollback from an off-repo bundle must restore the exact pre-repair tip and diagnostic manifest if any batch or assertion fails.
